discord.lead: Recreates a server's categories, channels and custom emoji as a Pollis group, in the same order. Messages stay on Discord, and people join through an invite link.
discord.howTo: Export the server with DiscordChatExporter on this computer: JSON format, with media. Add discord-guild.json beside it for roles, private channels and exact order. Pollis never needs your Discord login.
discord.peopleLead: Discord shares no email addresses, so nobody is invited automatically. Share the group's invite link with these people, then make the marked ones admins once they join.
discord.emojiImageRemote: Only a Discord link; export again with media
discord.noteNoSnapshot: Without discord-guild.json, channel order follows creation date and empty categories are left out.

slack.lead: Recreates a workspace's channels, their purpose and topic, and its custom emoji as a Pollis group. Messages stay on Slack, and people join by invite.
slack.howTo: A workspace admin downloads the export from Slack's settings (Import/Export Data, then Export). Choose the ZIP as downloaded, or the folder it unpacks to. Add slack-workspace.json beside it for custom emoji and user groups. Pollis never needs your Slack login.
slack.peopleLead: Everyone whose Slack email belongs to a Pollis account gets an invite to the group. Share the group's invite link with everyone else, then make the marked ones admins once they join.
slack.emojiImageRemote: Only a Slack link; add its picture to the snapshot's emoji folder
slack.noteNoWorkspaceSnapshot: Without slack-workspace.json, custom emoji and user groups aren't known, and the group is named after the export's file name.
slack.includeArchivedDetail_one: {{count}} archived channel is left out unless you include it.
slack.includeArchivedDetail_other: {{count}} archived channels are left out unless you include them.
slack.includeArchivedOn: Archived channels are included and marked.
slack.inviteByEmail: Invite people who already use Pollis
slack.inviteByEmailDetail_one: When you import, {{count}} Slack email is checked for a Pollis account, and its owner gets a group invite. Nobody joins until they accept.
slack.inviteByEmailDetail_other: When you import, {{count}} Slack emails are checked for Pollis accounts, and their owners get a group invite. Nobody joins until they accept.

page.nothingToDo: Everything in this export is already in the group. Importing again changes nothing.
page.targetExistingDetail: Adds only what's missing; nothing is changed or removed.

plan.noteForum: Forum, imported as a text channel
plan.noteStage: Stage, imported as a voice channel

plan.skipArchived: Archived; include archived channels to bring it

plan.emojiAliasMissing: Another name for {{target}}, which isn't imported
plan.rolesLead: Pollis groups have members and admins.

plan.userGroupsLead: Pollis has no group mentions yet, so these are listed for reference and not imported.
plan.noteNoEmails: {{source}} shares no email addresses: people join through the invite link.

plan.noteEmailInvites_other: {{count}} people have an email address: those that belong to Pollis accounts get an invite. Everyone else joins through the invite link.

plan.noteUserGroups_other: {{count}} user groups are listed but not imported.

plan.notePrivate_other: {{count}} channels were private on {{source}}. Every member of a Pollis group can see every channel.

plan.noteHistory_other: Messages aren't imported: {{count}} messages stay on {{source}}.
